name: smugan
description: Quality gate, stack rules and reviewers for code written with Claude Code

ui_language.title: UI language
ui_language.description: Language code for the project's UI strings (pt-BR, en, es…) or off. With pt-BR, the ui-ptbr rule and the ui-strings check are added.

reply_language.title: Conversation language
reply_language.description: Language code the agent replies in (pt-BR, en, es…) or off to reply in the language you write in.

profile.title: Cost profile
profile.description: completo: reviewers on the conversation's model. economico: reviewers on sonnet. minimo: reviewers on haiku, without flow-critic. Cheaper reviewers find less; use the smaller profiles only for small tasks.

disable.title: Disabled parts
disable.description: Comma-separated list of what not to use: critic, flow-critic, smugan, smugan-build, smugan-finish or a stack rule (nextjs, supabase…). Disabled reviewers and skills are refused and removed from the instructions; disabled rules are not taught. Empty or none: nothing disabled.
